findings.text: test_cutover_rejects_a_label_the_document_does_not_carry never calls check_cutover and writes tmp_path/cutover.json without reading it, so the title claims a refusal by scripts/rename/cutover.py that the tool does not implement and the assertion exercises only the test-local label_disagreements() helper.
the assertion hard-codes Installed units, the document_label of whichever row happens to be first with origin inventory, so reordering cutover.json's inventory reddens a correct edit.

the tests/test_logs receipt names the 18-item run at 5603af804, not the 21-test reviewed head, so the two reviewed commits' own passing run is recorded only in the agent transcript rather than a gate log.
